criteria.requirement: Implement csvkit.cleaning.clean_rows(reader, *,max_rows=10000,max_errors=1000,**RowChecker_options), clean_file(stream,reader_options=None,**options), immutable CleanResult(schema,header,rows,errors) and CleanIssue(line_number,code,message). Reuse the actual RowChecker and agate reader, including physical multiline line numbers and late empty-column removal, without returning before file-level checks. Do not retain raw error rows, close caller streams, write stdout/stderr or call sys.exit. Enforce nonnegative non-bool budgets, conflicting fixes, full completion and explicit CleanLimitError instead of partial success; propagate IO/errors. Preserve RowChecker/CLI APIs.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
